mapper.select: SELECT nd.id, nd.region_id, nd.node_id, nd.diagnosis_tag, nd.high_value_patent_count, nd.total_patent_count, nd.enterprise_count, nd.national_enterprise_count, nd.local_enterprise_count, nd.local_enterprise_share, nd.diagnosis_basis, nd.diagnosis_date, nd.created_at, n.name AS node_name, n.chain_id, n.layer FROM node_diagnosis nd INNER JOIN chain_node n ON nd.node_id = n.id AND n.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT region_id, node_id, MAX(diagnosis_date) AS max_date FROM node_diagnosis WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY region_id, node_id ) latest ON nd.region_id = latest.region_id AND nd.node_id = latest.node_id AND nd.diagnosis_date = latest.max_date WHERE nd.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY n.chain_id ASC, n.sort_order ASC

SELECT nd.diagnosis_tag, COUNT(DISTINCT nd.node_id) AS node_count, SUM(nd.total_patent_count) AS total_patents, SUM(nd.high_value_patent_count) AS total_high_value_patents, SUM(nd.enterprise_count) AS total_enterprises FROM node_diagnosis nd INNER JOIN ( SELECT region_id, node_id, MAX(diagnosis_date) AS max_date FROM node_diagnosis WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY region_id, node_id ) latest ON nd.region_id = latest.region_id AND nd.node_id = latest.node_id AND nd.diagnosis_date = latest.max_date WHERE nd.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY nd.diagnosis_tag ORDER BY CASE nd.diagnosis_tag WHEN '强链' THEN 1 WHEN '补链' THEN 2 WHEN '弱链' THEN 3 WHEN '缺链' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
SELECT * FROM node_diagnosis WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY diagnosis_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM node_diagnosis WHERE node_id = #{nodeId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY diagnosis_date DESC

SELECT nd.* FROM node_diagnosis nd INNER JOIN chain_node n ON nd.node_id = n.id AND n.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ( SELECT nd2.region_id, nd2.node_id, MAX(nd2.diagnosis_date) AS max_date FROM node_diagnosis nd2 INNER JOIN chain_node n2 ON nd2.node_id = n2.id AND n2.is_deleted = 0 WHERE nd2.is_deleted = 0 AND n2.chain_id = #{chainId} GROUP BY nd2.region_id, nd2.node_id ) latest ON nd.region_id = latest.region_id AND nd.node_id = latest.node_id AND nd.diagnosis_date = latest.max_date WHERE nd.is_deleted = 0 AND n.chain_id = #{chainId}
